scope: Compiled commented C, all accepted function instruction sites: register/SREG/next-PC/abstract byte-stack/call-continuation/RAM-MMIO-IRQ traces. Deterministic boundary and random states; exhaustive byte/SREG values per operand shape. RETI I corrected architecturally against known historical oracle omission. Not exhaustive multi-register combinations, full-path coverage, real PC stack, cycle timing, asynchronous IRQ or physical peripheral validation.
